context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://nearby-connect-93.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend gate is production-grade — 17 pytest assertions cover all the corner cases in the request; rerun with `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=<preview_url> pytest backend/tests/test_iter43_email_gate.py backend/tests/test_iter43_email_gate_extra.py -v`. Login response uses key 'access_token' (NOT 'token'). Admin login response uses key 'token'. Admin control-login testIDs: control-login-email/password/submit (NOT admin-* or login-*). Admin UI defaults to DEMO admin mode (X-Admin-Mode: demo) — users you register with /api/auth/register live in the live dataset and won't appear until you switch admin to Live mode via the DEMO/Live toggle in the top header. Verify-email gate testIDs: gate-email, gate-open-email, gate-resend, gate-check, gate-change, gate-new-email, gate-change-submit, gate-msg, gate-logout. Register flow testIDs (4-step): register-name/email/password → register-continue-account → register-dob-day/month/year → register-continue-age → register-consent-checkbox (+ optional register-marketing-checkbox) → register-submit → signup-success-title → signup-success-continue → /verify-email. Register flow requires date_of_birth + accept_policies:true. Mongo verified-flip pattern: `db.users.update_one({'email': ...}, {'$set': {'email_verified': True}})` from /app/backend/.env MONGO_URL + DB_NAME. Resend cap is 5/hour per account; change-unverified consumes the same bucket (backend test confirms 4 resends + 1 change = 6th resend returns 429).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Iter43 mandatory email verification gate is correctly implemented server-side (enforce_email_verification middleware with _VERIFY_EXEMPT allowlist covering auth/me, email/resend-verification, email/change-unverified, vibes, users/me/email-preferences, DELETE users/me; _pro_public excludes unverified pro owners; discovery query excludes unverified user IDs) and client-side (index.tsx + login.tsx redirect gate + verify-email.tsx full-screen gate with resend cooldown + AppState auto-refresh + change-email inline form + logout). Demo accounts (is_demo=true) correctly bypass the gate at both the server middleware and the client redirect check. Branded verify page has orrbbit-logo img and clean error copy with no framework leaks.
